liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Eyes runs almost twenty minutes through multiple themes including Solomon's, then closes into China Doll; reviewer counts it as the third version ever; Reviewer praises Bobby's tasteful playing in this early Eyes, likening it to the 02/09/73 Eyes [8][10]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): A Bear cassette excerpt has a stunning jam running from He's Gone through Truckin', a jam, The Other One, Eyes and China Doll [5]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls this one of the best Other One versions they have ever heard [6]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Reviewer's first Dead show; Sugar Magnolia felt like a perfect moment [14]
- Box of Rain moved a homesick reviewer, who had just returned to Chicago from northern California, to tears of joy [12]

## The recordings

- **gd73-02-19.set2sbd.fink.15589.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 87 min; rated 4.19/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Good sound, but an unfortunate cut falls in the jam leading into Eyes [7]
- **gd1973-02-19.set2.sbd.miller.83023.flac16**: soundboard; 7 songs; 86 min; rated 4.42/5 by 19 [2]. Said about its sound: Minor azimuth issues before the tape flip between The Other One and Eyes; sound improves afterward [2]
- **gd1973-02-19.sbd.jim.jeffrey.12826.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 5 songs; 70 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- The two-disc release is incomplete, but the He's Gone to Eyes medley is the highlight [8]
- Reviewer recalls the old, dirty amphitheatre with a rowdy crowd throwing rocks through skylights; Box of Rain felt like home [12]
- The amphitheater was a dump with character; cattle could be heard outside the doors [14]
- Reviewer ranks the second set among the best overall second sets of 1973 [6]
- Reviewer says the Maples show through to this one are all worth having [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-02-19.set2sbd.fink.15589.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard lineage: MC > C > DAT > SS > CDR > EAC > SHN, extracted and encoded by Alan J Fink [1]
- **gd1973-02-19.set2.sbd.miller.83023.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Ampex C-90) -> Dat (44.1k) D [2]. Also: Source is a DAT from Steve Rolfe; the tuning track was patched in from shnid 15589 [2]
- **gd1973-02-19.sbd.jim.jeffrey.12826.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by jim@juddcreek; source: SBD>MC>C>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN [3]
